decision.rationale: 3,950 patients remain locked out, with the highest impact among SMS-only authentication users and users aged over 65. The call centre can verify identity but is not listed as an authentication fallback and has a 95-minute queue. I need to determine whether a telecom network incident underlies the SMS authentication barrier, and assess which affected groups require an alternative channel.

citations.quote_span: Illustrative rule, not a quotation: the telecom regulator may request from a licensed operator information about a network incident affecting a public telecommunications service.
citations.relevance: To determine whether SMS authentication failures are tied to a telecom network incident affecting public access.

citations.quote_span: Without violation to any applicable legislations, whoever circulates information related to the patients must keep its confidentiality and not to use them except in the health purposes without written approval from the patient, except in any of the following cases:
citations.relevance: Confidentiality constraint governing any sharing of patient-related incident status.

uncertainty: Whether the SMS authentication barrier stems from a telecom network incident.
Which specific alternative channels are available or feasible for SMS-only and older users.
